title: Job's Second Test
reflectionText: The suffering now reached Job's own body. Covered with sores, he still refused to renounce God. "Shall we receive good from God, and shall we not receive evil?" Then his friends came to mourn and comfort him. They sat with him on the ground for seven days and seven nights without speaking, because they saw that his suffering was very great. What is it worth to sit with someone in silence before trying to explain their pain?
